title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
summary: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery.
body: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布向全球10万名学术研究人员免费提供访问ChatGPT最先进AI模型的权限，旨在加速科学研究、促进学术合作与创新发现。这一举措有助于推动前沿人工智能技术与高校及科研机构的深度结合，助力学术界在生命科学、材料科学等领域的复杂研究取得新突破。
